purpose: Reviewed execution/authority evidence only; absent reviews remain unclassified. No automatic reachability claims.

reviews.effect: Read-only projection of legacy log field 'provider' to filterable provider_id; no GET/POST, file write or rights grant

retirements.evidence: The provider-keyed Gtk action branch and BnF-only label were physically removed; Core now inspects the installed exact live session's static ACSM stage profile and methods. Consent, stage and import remain unchanged.
Core brand comparison deleted and replaced by an installed provider's explicit, non-secret, read-only public navigation account option; no new per-provider dispatch in generic Core.

The special Core facade config.paris_base_url() call was deleted; the installed Paris plugin declares base_url/legacy_config_key and the provider-neutral resolver reads only configuration and validates public URLs.
Public identity account enumeration no longer accepts an omitted identity. Blank/invalid identity fails before any storage/account lookup, and a GTK selection switch cannot widen scope.

retirements.replacement: AcquisitionBroker.eligible_accounts(item, *, identity_id: str), exact provider/credential filtering
retirements.evidence: No implicit account enumeration from current GTK identity; ambiguous account IDs and credentials remain guarded before acquisition. ABI now requires caller scope.

The display-only ADEPT activity predicate no longer reads current_identity/current_account/last_loans. It obtains a v2 cache keyed by exact identity/provider/credential/borrower, validates each Loan and requires active status; legacy Entitlement only correlates already-observed exact provider loan, never grants rights. One historical method signature remains a thin delegation.

Confirmed manual local-materialization submits a provider-neutral kind, with identical USER_ACTION, origin=user, progress and cancellation contract; TaskRunner gives the same GLib.PRIORITY_DEFAULT final receipt to this kind. Historical kobo-acquisition strings remain only inert bounded telemetry compatibility (no active producer or privileged scheduling).

Public metadata library projection requires an explicit identity before calling the service or scanning SQLite/files. No fallback to UI current_identity; exact identity is forwarded unchanged. Direct legacy GUI service API is separately retained as a navigation-only compatibility entrypoint.

The live SynchronizationBrokerImpl.synchronize validates identity and enumerates enabled connected source refs, then synchronize_source revalidates source and consent. GTK callbacks still call sync_action_scope_current to refuse stale display.

retirements.evidence: The Core facade now refuses absent/invalid/stale provider connection owners before attributing a private source. Direct acquisition telemetry does not fall back to current_identity when exact binding fails; non-Paris ADEPT historical status instead returns disabled with identity unproven. No rights, consent, or storage owner is invented.
